verdict_reason: Generic page wrapper is correct but carries three fields no caller reads.

todos.issue: MdmProductPage declares page (l.9), size (l.10) and totalPages (l.12), but CommoditySearchService and SpeciesCheckService read only content() and totalElements(); MdmService's empty-page fallback also sets only those two. Breaks 'Build only what this change makes reachable'.
todos.fix: Must: MdmProductPage holds only content and totalElements until a caller reads more. One way: delete page, size and totalPages, and the .page(0)/.size(100) builder calls in CommoditySearchServiceTest.
